area: U.S. and Canadian Atlantic Continental Margin
expedition: New England and Canada ROV and Mapping
purpose: and Description Coral Conservation Area, designed to protect deepwater coral and sponge communities from bottom contact fishing. The purpose of the dive was to characterize the deep-sea benthic community inside this current area of interest, which is under consideration for expansion of the protected area. Furthermore, the dive sought to investigate the geological origins of this site, presumed to be composed of glacial trough mouth fan materials.
